intro.title: Next.js App Router Fundamentals
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple multi-page web application using Next.js 13+ with the App Router. You'll learn the core concept of file-based routing, where the structure of your files automatically defines the routes of your application. The main technologies involved are Next.js, React components, and special files like page.tsx and layout.tsx. By the end, you'll understand how to create pages, navigate between them, and use layouts for shared UI, all within the Angular track's TypeScript environment.
intro.usecase: The Next.js App Router is the foundation for building modern web applications with complex navigation and data loading patterns. You'll see this in e-commerce platforms where product listings, details pages, and checkout flows need seamless transitions with proper data fetching. Content-heavy sites like news portals and blogs use the App Router's file-based routing to organize articles, categories, and author pages while maintaining optimal performance. Enterprise dashboards leverage nested layouts to create consistent navigation headers and sidebars across analytics, user management, and reporting sections.
